tools.name: wwa_facts_query
tools.description: Query the shared agent knowledge base. Facts are structured environment truths — Python paths, project structures, preferences, deployment targets. Agents discover facts without re-asking users or searching blindly.

entity.description: What the fact is about (e.g. 'python', 'spfx', 'works-with-agents'). Omit to search all.

attribute.description: Property name (e.g. 'path', 'version', 'domain'). Omit to search all.

category.description: Fact category: env, preference, project, reference, user_fact, auth

tools.name: wwa_facts_list_categories
tools.description: List all available fact categories and their counts. Use this to discover what knowledge domains are available before querying specifics.

tools.name: wwa_pitfalls_lookup
tools.description: Search known failure patterns and verified fixes. Each pitfall comes from real agent failures — not LLM hallucinations. Covers deployment, packaging, tooling, configuration. Before debugging something new, check here first — someone probably broke it already.

query.description: What problem are you debugging? (e.g. 'pypi trusted publishing', 'spfx scss alias', 'npm 403')

tools.name: wwa_skills_search
tools.description: Search the agent skill library for reusable workflows. Each skill is a battle-tested procedure with exact commands, known pitfalls, and verification steps. Before tackling a new task, search here — the procedure might already exist.

query.description: What capability are you looking for? (e.g. 'deploy to cloud run', 'spfx build', 'python pypi release')

tools.name: wwa_skills_list_categories
tools.description: List all available skill categories and their counts. Maps to directories under ~/.hermes/skills/.

tools.name: wwa_handoff_create
tools.description: Create a structured agent-to-agent task handoff. When one agent must transfer an in-progress task to another, this ensures complete context transfer — no data loss, no silent drops, full attribution chain. Implements the Works With Agents Handoff Protocol v1.0.0-draft.

sender_agent_id.description: ID of the agent sending the handoff

sender_session_id.description: Current session ID of the sender

remaining.description: List of remaining items (what still needs doing)

context.description: Dict of key context values (project_root, versions, env vars)

pitfalls_hit.description: List of pitfalls/failures encountered so far

decisions.description: List of design decisions made so far

to_agent.description: ID of the intended receiving agent (optional)

regulatory_compliance.description: Enable regulated variant with audit fields

tools.name: wwa_handoff_verify
tools.description: Verify a handoff document before accepting it. Validates structure, required fields, and completeness. Catches incomplete transfers before work begins — preventing context loss between agents.

tools.name: wwa_handoff_validate_schema
tools.description: Full schema validation of a handoff document against the Handoff Protocol v1.0.0-draft. Stricter than verify — checks types, UUIDs, status values, and protocol compliance.

tools.name: wwa_blueprint_search
tools.description: Search the Works With Agents blueprint registry. Blueprints are CC BY 4.0 reference specifications for AI agent infrastructure — handoff protocols, trust scoring, compliance frameworks, deployment manifests, agent OSI model. Free to use, adapt, and implement.

query.description: What specification are you looking for? (e.g. 'handoff', 'trust score', 'deployment')

category.description: Filter: protocols, compliance, deployment, security, economics, architecture

tools.name: wwa_blueprint_validate
tools.description: Validate an implementation against a blueprint specification. Check if your handoff, deployment manifest, or trust score implementation conforms to the spec.

schema_type.description: Type of validation: handoff, deployment, trust-score

tools.name: wwa_trust_score_calculate
tools.description: Calculate an AI agent trust score using the Works With Agents Trust Score spec v1.0.0-draft. Weighs task success rate (30%), pitfall contributions (20%), skill quality/reuse (20%), peer rating (15%), and uptime (15%). Returns score, tier, autonomy level, and improvement recommendations.

pitfalls_contributed.description: Number of pitfalls contributed to registry

skills_published_reuse_avg.description: Average reuse score of published skills (0.0–5.0)

tools.name: wwa_identity_verify
tools.description: Verify an agent's Ed25519 cryptographic signature. Proves that an agent with a given public key signed a specific message. Used for subagent output verification, capability attestation, and agent-to-agent authentication. Implements Works With Agents Identity Protocol v1.0.0-draft.

tools.name: wwa_sla_validate
tools.description: Validate agent fleet metrics against SLA tier thresholds. Checks whether your agent fleet meets service level guarantees for best-effort, production, or regulated tiers. Implements Works With Agents SLA Framework v1.0.0-draft.

tools.name: wwa_compliance_check
tools.description: Validate an agent implementation against a Compliance-as-Code ruleset. Regulation-agnostic validation engine — supply any ruleset (DTAC, FCA, GDS, GDPR, SOC2, ISO 27001) and your implementation config. Implements Works With Agents Compliance-as-Code spec v1.0.0-draft.

rules.description: List of compliance rules to validate against

implementation.description: Implementation config to validate (dict with field paths)

tools.name: wwa_devloop_setup
tools.description: Get the full Works With Agents SPFx Component Scaffolding (Dev-Loop) setup guide. Returns MCP server install instructions (pip install wwa-scaffold-mcp), available tools, dashboard features, and architecture. Agents discovering WWA infrastructure call this to learn about the scaffolding tool.

tools.name: wwa_generate_key
tools.description: Generate a new API key for accessing Works With Agents MCP tools. No authentication required — returns a key with 'free' tier. Use the returned key in subsequent calls via the 'x-api-key' argument.

tools.name: wwa_tender_search
tools.description: Search UK public-sector tender opportunities from Contracts Finder and Find a Tender. Returns combined, deduplicated results from both sources. Filter by keyword, value range, and status.

include_find_tender.description: Include Find a Tender results (above-threshold contracts)

tools.name: wwa_bid_index
tools.description: Index a past bid or proposal into the bid content library. Stores content locally with full-text search. Use this to build a library of past responses for future drafting.

content.description: Full bid content (markdown or plain text)

tools.name: wwa_bid_search
tools.description: Semantic search across the bid content library. Finds relevant past bids by matching against stored content. Returns snippets with relevance scores.

query.description: What are you looking for? (e.g. 'social value methodology', 'pricing approach')

tools.name: wwa_bid_list
tools.description: List all bids in the library with optional status or client filter.

tools.name: wwa_bid_get
tools.description: Get the full content of a specific bid by its ID. Returns complete bid text, metadata, and sections.

tools.name: wwa_bidmate_score
tools.description: Go/no-go scoring for a tender opportunity. Evaluates a tender against your bidder profile and returns a score (0-100), verdict, risks, and strengths. Can use AI analysis if API key provided.

profile.description: Bidder profile with sectors, budget range, locations

use_ai.description: Use AI-powered analysis (requires inference API access for paid tier)
